interface.defaultPrompt: Use Hallmark Design to plan, build, redesign, or audit this interface. Preserve existing functionality and verify accessibility and responsive behavior.
interface.longDescription: A skills-first adaptation of Hallmark's design workflow. Guide an AI coding agent through purposeful interface design, preservation-aware redesign, and evidence-based UI audits. The upstream repository contains a larger theme catalog and runnable browser lint scripts; those runtime assets are not embedded in this lightweight plugin package.

name: hallmark-design
description: A design workflow for coding agents to create, redesign, and audit polished, purposeful interfaces with accessibility, responsive-layout, and anti-template checks.
